summary.text: William Wivell is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 2A, in Washington and Frederick counties, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Washington County commissioner with an accounting background, he has served in the House since 2015 and sits on the Economic Matters Committee.

paragraphs.text: Wivell was born in Hagerstown and graduated from Smithsburg High School in 1982.

He earned an A.A. in accounting and business from Hagerstown Community College in 1984, a B.A. in accounting and computer programming from Shepherd University in 1986, and an M.B.A. from Mount Saint Mary's University in 1991.
He worked as business manager of St. James School and served on the Washington County Board of County Commissioners from 1998 to 2010 and again from 2014 to 2015.
Wivell was appointed to the House of Delegates on March 13, 2015, and was sworn in three days later; he was first elected to the House in November 2018.

He sits on the Economic Matters Committee and its Economic Development, Housing and Real Property, and Land Use and Zoning subcommittees, and has chaired the Washington County House Delegation since 2019.
He is a member of the Maryland Association of Certified Public Accountants and the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants.
